tasks.title: Implement retained synthesis, abstractions and admitted growth
deliverables: Example-guided synthesis, conjecture/generalization and separate persistent result/experience/artifact stores
acceptance: Retain logical results, heuristic search experience and executable improvements as distinct reusable products.

Stale/failed candidates, learned templates and upstream retained programs have transparent lifecycle/disposition rules.

Map and deliberately preserve/repair all three original code-growth mechanisms: catalogue/toolchain generation and checking, ordered pipeline synthesis with differential samples, and typed bounded enumeration with retained library. They are not interchangeable evidence or one generic search label.

Ordinary users may inspect/use tentative artifacts under exact user-test/backend observations and outstanding obligations; candidate lifecycle and safe explicit execution are separate from formal capability admission.

Scope observational equivalence to the actual differential/user samples unless stronger evidence establishes a general contract; later generalization or library activation passes appropriate admission and operational qualification.

Feedback and gap-derived learning are attributable versioned proposals with exposure/retention history; qualify against binding interference/negative space and publish atomically without unauthorized validation effects.

Nonpublishing evaluation/benchmark runs isolate both in-memory and persistent learned state. Retained objects declare request/session/global owner scope, exact identity/dependencies and activation authority; disabling disk writes alone is not isolation.

Restore retained candidates with recorded evidence and scope rather than admitting them by name/import. Language/toolchain choice, emitted-artifact delivery and missing-toolchain/timeout/mismatch distinctions remain covered for the three original mechanisms.

Implement the five growth tiers concretely: data/observations/configuration reuse family kernels; reifiable declarations reuse bundle under controlled native lineage; plans use the compiled interpreter; hot plans optionally specialize; new carrier/kernel/foreign binding/code setup rebuilds/qualifies an affected bundle.

Ordinary learning, source observations and retained plans do not rebuild the application or mutate code setup invisibly. Accepted developments use canonical .thy recipes/source with explicit private workspace and publication state.
